::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Febry 19th 1897  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell
:::

Dear Madam
I think yours is a useful paper, and I shall be glad to have it for [Mothers in Council](organizations/other_82.qmd) when there is room for it, but the April number is full

yours truly
C M Yonge
